documented_findings: cargo vendor vendors crates.io and git dependencies into the specified local path, and after completion that vendor directory contains the remote sources for the specified dependencies.

After vendoring completes, Cargo prints the configuration necessary to use those vendored sources to stdout; the documentation says to add it or redirect it to Cargo configuration, usually .cargo/config.toml for the current package.
Vendored sources are treated as read-only, like registry and git sources.
By default cargo vendor ignores [source] configuration while downloading crates; --respect-source-config makes it read and use that configuration instead.
